scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/datoms build && bun run --cwd apps/movie-finder build:client
scripts.check: bun run check:quick && bun test --bail && bun run test:e2e && echo '✅ Checks passed'
scripts.check:fast: bun run check:quick && bun run test:fast --bail && echo '✅ Fast checks passed'
scripts.check:quick: bun run format && bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run cir-deps && echo '✅ Quick checks passed'
scripts.dev: bun x concurrently "bun run client" "bun run server"
scripts.docker: bun run docker:down && bun run docker:up
scripts.preview: docker build --no-cache -t datoms-preview -f Dockerfile . && docker run --name datoms-preview --rm --env-file .env -p 3847:3847 datoms-preview
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/datoms build && bun run --cwd packages/datoms typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/movie-finder typecheck
